selected_inheritance_policy.classification: 8.4.17 conditions eligibility on the named han lexical community, not on the preserved h/n sounds of han.
selected_inheritance_policy.source_basis: Nyāsa 1.1.56 distinguishes varṇamātra-āśrita from samudāya-āśrita operations. Kāśikā 1.1.56 explicitly retains han-conditioned pada after vadha substitution in āvadhiṣṭa. 8.4.17 is read as dhātu membership; its tiP-wording excludes yaṅ-luk, as qualified by the commentaries.
selected_inheritance_policy.target: The existing n of the inner prefix ni, not an invented h/n segment in the replacement.
selected_inheritance_policy.retained_identity: DP_02_0002, selected ordinary P history, ordered preverbs and sense; no yaṅ-luk request.
selected_inheritance_policy.not_inherited: Original phoneme inventory, original one-vowel shape and any nonexistent root nasal. Letter-conditioned rules must inspect the replacement and their own upadeśa conditions.

ja: 6.4.36 replaces han by ja before hi. The same-host visibility of 6.4.22 prevents 6.4.105 from seeing this new a as a reason to delete hi. Thus the ordinary 2sg is jahi, with the inherited inner-ni membership under the selected policy.
vadha: 2.4.42 is confined by 2.4.35 to ārdhadhātuka liṅ, and 2.4.43 supplies P-luṅ. Vadha is a-ending at the relevant upadeśa; 6.4.48 removes that a. The Kāśikā 7.2.10 itself uses avadhīt as the ekāc exclusion control. Do not inherit han’s aniṭ outcome across the replacement.
pada_limit: The option in 2.4.44 is specifically A-pada luṅ. It does not give these P histories an optional unsubstituted han aorist; no new A-pada is admitted.
tatan_guard: The four -tāt word/slot readings require āśis under 7.1.35, as in PG280. Other imperative readings retain their admitted ordinary/blessing request contexts.
negative_controls: Do not turn ja into gha by pretending its new j is the old h.
Do not restore a root n into vadha to run 8.4.22/23.
Do not treat the an-al wording as permission to inherit every original sound property.
Do not apply han→vadha to the ordinary optatives of PG279.
Do not label the derived prefixed ja/vadha words as direct textual attestations.
closed_grid: The four named profiles have all ten selected lakāras and nine person-number keys, 360 distinct positions. Direct full-word corroboration of the prefixed replacements remains open; this is a declared written grammar relation, not executable or universal validation.
domain: The four inherited, sense-qualified ordered pra+ni / pari+ni P profiles. Unaccented Classical pause forms; no A-pada or yaṅ-luk expansion.
observed_and_composed: The ja/vadha forms with the two ordered preverbs are source-backed WRITTEN DERIVATIONS under the explicitly selected non-al lexical-membership application of 1.1.56 and 8.4.17. They are NOT literal attestations from the cited commentaries. The traditional sources directly give the bare substitutions, the non-al/community distinction and the rule-specific conditions. Twenty-seven bare archive cells are a separate comparison. Independent literal ordered-ni examples remain an open corroboration question. No new source-token observations or nominal positions are credited.
